description: Core full-stack developer contributing to the Digital HealthTech Platform. Responsible for backend architecture, high-throughput wearable telemetry data pipelines, enterprise-grade OIDC/SSO identity systems, scalable management portals, and AI workflow automations.
highlights: Engineered real-time telemetry ingestion pipelines processing health data (heart rate, step count, sleep stages, SpO2, active calories) across major smart wearable ecosystems: Huawei Health, Google Fit, Google Health Connect, and Apple HealthKit.
Utilized Redis Queue and background workers to ingest and process millions of daily telemetry events reliably without bottlenecks.

Architected dual-database storage leveraging partitioned time-series PostgreSQL alongside MySQL for transactional business logic; tuned SQL queries and multi-tier Redis caching to maintain sub-50ms dashboard API response times.

Built a centralized Identity Provider adhering to OpenID Connect and OAuth 2.0 standards (Authorization Code Flow with PKCE), securing Single Sign-On (SSO) across Web, Mobile, and enterprise portal clients.
Developed responsive B2B enterprise portals and administrative dashboards using Next.js, ReactJS, and Tailwind CSS, enabling intuitive corporate health management and organizational reporting.
Integrated AI solutions and Large Language Models (LLMs) to automate health metric summarization, routine medical reporting, and intelligent support capabilities.
Configured automated CI/CD deployment pipelines using Jenkins and containerized application services with Docker, ensuring consistent, repeatable releases.
